coverage.reason: Says the board selects by majority vote of trustees who are not interested persons, covering independent-trustee selection.
Does not mention that an all-independent audit committee permits omission under Rule 32a-4.
Does not state that a shareholder vote is trust-wide or that series may use different auditors.

local_error: “If the trust holds no annual meeting ... ratification may be omitted.” The supplied evidence identifies an all-independent audit committee as the basis for omitting ratification, not the absence of an annual meeting.
rationale: Point 1 is covered; required point 2 is omitted. The unsupported alternative omission condition is a material local error, capping the grade at partial.
